fields.name: StateFilters
fields.about: The transaction states to filter by: if empty, all transactions are returned; if non-empty, then only transactions matching one of the filtered states will be returned.

fields.name: ProducerIdFilters
fields.about: The producerIds to filter by: if empty, all transactions will be returned; if non-empty, only transactions which match one of the filtered producerIds will be returned.

fields.name: DurationFilter
fields.about: Duration (in millis) to filter by: if < 0, all transactions will be returned; otherwise, only transactions running longer than this duration will be returned.

fields.name: TransactionalIdPattern
fields.about: The transactional ID regular expression pattern to filter by: if it is empty or null, all transactions are returned; Otherwise then only the transactions matching the given regular expression will be returned.
